name: delayed-charge-succeeded
summary: charge.succeeded arrives 90 seconds late, after the app may have given up.
catches: Handler ignores or rejects a late success — customer paid, order never fulfilled.
diagnosis: Handler rejected or ignored a late charge.succeeded that still had a valid signature.
manual_check_required: Inspect the database — if the order is failed/cancelled while Stripe shows the charge succeeded, this is confirmed.
pass_detail: Endpoint accepted a charge.succeeded signed 90 seconds in the past.
